QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] Materials for the Experiment 3
QuestInfo.0: #p2154009#, the Black Wing mad scientist in #m310060000#, is starting another experiment. You shiver just thinking about it...
QuestInfo.1:
#p2154009# says he needs #b#p2154012#'s Heart#k for his experiment. You worry what will happen to #p2154012# if she doesn't have a heart... Can she function? #p2154009# doesn't seem to care at all... For now, go discuss it with #b#p2154007##k.



#i4032773# #t4032773# #b#c4032773#/1#k
QuestInfo.2: You gave #p2154009# the spare heart. #p2154009# knew you didn't find the two hearts yourself, but he didn't care.

0.0: Aren't you the one who helped me before? Yes you are, yes you are. I don't remember your face, but I recognize your walk and energy pattern. I need your help again. I am thinking of conducting a new experiment and I need you to bring me the materials for it.

yes.0: I simply require the #bheart of #p2154012##k, an android I created. Simple, right? Huh? What happens to the #p2154012# after its heart is gone? Well, it becomes inoperable, obviously. But why does that matter?

no.0: Hmm... I really thought that you would be able to do a good job. This is very unfortunate.

1.0: Ah, you've brought the #t4032773#... Good, good. Wait, this isn't #p2154012#'s heart. Well, I guess it doesn't matter. It's a #t4032773# regardless.

item.0: Have you not brought #p2154012#'s yet? I really need a #b#t4032773##k for my new experiment...
